 feat: generate animated leaderboard bar chart race #20 

 Copy link 

 Description

 wini83 
 opened on Sep 13, 2026 

 Issue body actions 

 Goal

 Generate an animated leaderboard visualization from historical SQLite snapshots, similar to the popular "bar chart race" videos used for rankings changing over time.

 This should remain a CLI/batch feature and produce a shareable artifact rather than introducing a web frontend.

 Depends on #18 .

 Example

 stravit charts bar-race --top 10 --output leaderboard.mp4

 Scope

 animate leaderboard values across snapshots

 reorder bars as participants move through the ranking

 show participant name and current value

 show current snapshot timestamp/date in each frame

 support configurable top N

 write MP4 output

 optionally support GIF if it comes essentially for free

 make animation speed/FPS configurable with sensible defaults

 Implementation notes

 Possible approaches:

 Matplotlib animation + FFmpeg

 bar_chart_race if the dependency proves maintained and flexible enough

 Prefer the option that gives us explicit control over styling and does not make the core data/query layer depend on the rendering library.

 FFmpeg availability should be detected and missing dependencies should result in a clear error message.

 Acceptance criteria

 animation uses historical data from feat: add reusable leaderboard history queries for visualizations  #18 

 bars reorder as ranking/value changes

 top-N can be configured

 MP4 is generated from the CLI

 generated video works in a headless Docker environment

 missing FFmpeg is handled with a useful error

 output path and basic animation timing can be configured

 README/help contains an example command
